sections.content: As part of the Battles of Brave Frontier 2 series, Baragan can be fought in The Savage Lion.

sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: One of the Seven Demonlords, charged with leading the beast brigade. Once banished from Ishgria, having tasted defeat, he ended up joining Nogreth. He helmed invasion after invasion as a demonlord, and his presence and strength is said to have encouraged countless beastmen to join his ranks. Among the men who fought for him, many prioritized serving him over Nogreth itself. Though a just warrior in battle, he also swore revenge on those who betrayed him.

He leads the beast brigade and is one of the seven Demonlords of Nogreth. ==In-Game Appearance== ===In Brave Frontier I=== As part of the [[Battles of Brave Frontier 2]] series, Baragan can be fought in [[The Savage Lion]]. ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== One of the Seven Demonlords, charged with leading the beast brigade. Once banished from Ishgria, having tasted defeat, he ended up joining Nogreth. He helmed invasion after invasion as a demonlord, and his presence and strength is said to have encouraged countless beastmen to join his ranks. Among the men who fought for him, many prioritized serving him over Nogreth itself. Though a just warrior in battle, he also swore revenge on those who betrayed him. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Baragan |element = Fire |image1 = Navi chara bf2 6 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 6 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 6 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 6 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 6 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 6 5.png |image6note = Hurt |image7 = Navi chara bf2 161 0.png |image7note = }} ==Trivia==
